questions.title: East to East (Cairo to Dhaka)
questions.question: Cairo is 30°E. Dhaka is 90°E. If it is 10:00 AM in Cairo, what time is it in Dhaka?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Both are East. Subtract degrees: 90° - 30° = 60°.
Step 2: 60 ÷ 15 = 4 Hours.
Step 3: Dhaka is ahead. 10:00 + 4 = 14:00 (2:00 PM).

questions.title: Crossing the Line (West to East)
questions.question: City A is 30°W. City B is 30°E. If it is 8:00 AM in City A, what time is it in City B?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: West to East (Cross 0). Add degrees: 30° + 30° = 60°.
Step 2: 60 ÷ 15 = 4 Hours.
Step 3: East is ahead. 8:00 + 4 = 12:00.

questions.title: The Football Match
questions.question: A match starts at 4:00 PM in London (0°). What time should a fan in Baghdad (45°E) watch it?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: 45° ÷ 15 = 3 Hours.
Step 2: Baghdad is East (Ahead). Add time.
Step 3: 4:00 PM + 3 hours = 7:00 PM.

questions.title: Reverse: Finding West
questions.question: It is 2:00 PM at GMT. City Z is at 11:00 AM. What is the longitude of City Z?
questions.explanation:
Step 1: Time diff: 14:00 - 11:00 = 3 Hours.
Step 2: 3 × 15 = 45°.
Step 3: Time is Behind (AM < PM), so it is West.
Answer: 45° West.
